title: orch workspace directory v1
description: Written by `orch relay refresh` to .agents/skills/orch-relay/workspaces.json (from the refresh snapshot). Lists every workspace with a pair rule to or from this one. Agents read it to decide where to hand work over. Phones get the same items for the workspaces they may reach (can_send/accepts_from left out). Unknown fields are allowed and kept.

description.description: Free text by the admin: what this workspace does

online.description: Seen by the relay in the last 2 minutes, at refresh time

can_send.description: What THIS workspace may send to it (pair rule self → it)

accepts_from.description: What it may send to THIS workspace (pair rule it → self)
